title: Crash sites with Bob Wood that turned out to be US planes
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Crash sites with Bob Wood that turned out to be US planes, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: bobwood and I went to a number of Crash sites with him which all turned out to be our planes

plain: A man named Joe McMoneagle told podcast host Jesse Michels that he went with a man named Bob Wood to a number of crash sites in the United States. He says that every one of them turned out to be an American plane, not anything stranger. No dates or places are given.
